info.title: BizAI Business Rules
info.description: AI-powered business rules management. Enables businesses to define and manage rules that guide AI agent behavior. Each rule has a category code from the catalog of business rule categories, and each category belongs to a topic: Reply to clients, AI Receptionist, BizAI Chat, Notes, Preferences & Priorities, or Knowledge & Files.

field.description: The name of the field that caused the error (e.g., "category_code", "content").

message.description: A human-readable error message describing the issue.

retry_after.description: Seconds until the next request is allowed. Present on a 429 response only (e.g., 42).

content.description: The content or text of the business rule (e.g., "Always use a friendly and professional tone"). For FAQ rules, include both the question and answer. At most 20,000 characters.
content.example: Always use a friendly and professional tone

sort_order.description: Sort order for displaying rules within a category (e.g., 0). Lower values appear first. Defaults to 0 if not provided.

category_code.description: The category code of the business rule. It must be the code of an active catalog category, see `GET /v3/ai/business_rule_categories?is_active=true`. Today these codes are `tone_of_voice`, `policies_and_info`, `things_to_avoid`, `lead_handling`, `whats_important`, `faq`, `knowledge_item`, `document` and `client_facing_bot_policies`. An unknown code returns 400 (e.g., "tone_of_voice", "knowledge_item").

metadata.description: Free-form metadata stored with the rule, for example the question and answer of an FAQ rule. Only an app token that acts for a staff member can set it; a staff token gets `null`. Serialized size at most 4,096 characters (e.g., {"question": "What are your hours?", "answer": "9 to 5"}).

topic.description: The topic of the rule (e.g., "ai_receptionist"). The pair of `topic` and `category_code` must be an active catalog category, otherwise 400 `invalid_topic_for_category`. Without `topic`, the entry point places the rule (`knowledge_page` in `knowledge_and_files`, `receptionist_training` and `receptionist_setup` in `ai_receptionist`), and otherwise the default topic of the category does. The response tells which in `placed_by`.

title.description: A short title of the rule (e.g., "No price quotes to leads"). `null` clears it on update.

description.description: A description of the rule. `null` clears it on update.

load_mode.description:
The own load mode of the rule. `null` or no value means the default load mode of the catalog category.

Available values:
* `always` - Agents get the rule in every list call.
* `search` - Agents get the rule only from search.

entry_point.description: Where the write comes from (e.g., "api"). No value means `api`. Together with the token it sets `author_type` and the confirmation of the rule. A staff token writes as `owner`, confirmed, except `bizai_chat` and `receptionist_training` (`owner_via_ai`, confirmed), `setup_generation` (`platform`) and `partner_bulk_import` (`partner`). An app token that acts for a staff member writes as `partner`, not confirmed, whatever the entry point. Only vcita's own AI agents get `owner` or `owner_via_ai` from an entry point.

evidence.description: Where the rule came from. Only an app token that acts for a staff member can set it; a staff token gets `null` on create and keeps the stored value on update. Serialized size at most 4,096 characters.

uid.description: The uid of the source, for example the conversation uid.

confidence.description: How sure the writer is, from 0 to 1.

reasoning.description: Why the writer created the rule.

search_aliases.description: Customer phrasings of the rule, used by search (e.g., ["where do I park"]). `null` clears them on update.

content.description: The content or text of the business rule (e.g., "Always maintain a warm, friendly, and professional tone in all client communications"). At most 20,000 characters.

status.description:
The status of the business rule.

Available values:
* `active` - The rule is in effect and used by the AI agent.
* `pending_approval` - The rule is awaiting staff review.
* `inactive` - The rule is deactivated and not used by the AI agent.

sort_order.description: Sort order for displaying rules within a category (e.g., 0). Lower values appear first.

category_code.description: The category code of the business rule. It must be the code of an active catalog category, see `GET /v3/ai/business_rule_categories?is_active=true`. Today these codes are `tone_of_voice`, `policies_and_info`, `things_to_avoid`, `lead_handling`, `whats_important`, `faq`, `knowledge_item`, `document` and `client_facing_bot_policies`. An unknown code returns 400 (e.g., "tone_of_voice", "knowledge_item").

topic.description: The topic of the rule (e.g., "ai_receptionist"). The pair of `topic` and `category_code` must be an active catalog category, otherwise 400 `invalid_topic_for_category`. Without `topic`, the entry point places the rule (`knowledge_page` in `knowledge_and_files`, `receptionist_training` and `receptionist_setup` in `ai_receptionist`), and otherwise the default topic of the category does. The response tells which in `placed_by`.

title.description: A short title of the rule (e.g., "No price quotes to leads"). `null` clears it on update.

description.description: A description of the rule. `null` clears it on update.

load_mode.description:
The own load mode of the rule. `null` or no value means the default load mode of the catalog category.

Available values:
* `always` - Agents get the rule in every list call.
* `search` - Agents get the rule only from search.

entry_point.description: Where the write comes from (e.g., "api"). No value means `api`. Together with the token it sets `author_type` and the confirmation of the rule. A staff token writes as `owner`, confirmed, except `bizai_chat` and `receptionist_training` (`owner_via_ai`, confirmed), `setup_generation` (`platform`) and `partner_bulk_import` (`partner`). An app token that acts for a staff member writes as `partner`, not confirmed, whatever the entry point. Only vcita's own AI agents get `owner` or `owner_via_ai` from an entry point.

evidence.description: Where the rule came from. Only an app token that acts for a staff member can set it. `null` clears it, and a tone copy keeps its `copied_from`. A staff token gets `null` on create and keeps the stored value on update. Serialized size at most 4,096 characters.

uid.description: The uid of the source, for example the conversation uid.

confidence.description: How sure the writer is, from 0 to 1.

reasoning.description: Why the writer created the rule.

search_aliases.description: Customer phrasings of the rule, used by search (e.g., ["where do I park"]). `null` clears them on update.

UpdateBusinessRuleRequestDto.description: The fields in the body change; fields that are not in the body stay. A change of `content`, `title`, `description`, `category_code`, `topic`, `load_mode` or `search_aliases` sets the author of the rule again from the token and the entry point. A change of only `status` or `sort_order` keeps the author. Server fields such as `business_uid`, `author_type`, `placed_by` and `confirmed_at` in the body are ignored.

total.description: Total number of history records matching the query

business_rules.description: List of BusinessRules. Without `page` the list holds every matching rule, at most 500.

BulkImportJobCreatedResponse.description: Response when bulk import job is successfully created

job_uid.description: Unique identifier of the created bulk import job (e.g., "job-a1b2c3d4-5678-90ef-ghij-klmnopqrstuv").

status.description: Initial status of the job, always `processing` when the job is created: the job was sent for rule generation.

message.description: A human-readable status message (e.g., "Bulk import job created successfully. Processing will begin shortly.").

ListMeta.description: The settings of the business, and the paging values when the request carries `page`.

rules_mode.description:
How the business reads its rules (e.g., "legacy", "topics").

* `legacy` - Readers get the legacy list and filter by category.
* `topics` - Readers get the scoped list of their topics.

gate_mode.description: The write gate mode of the business (e.g., "off", "warn").

receptionist_rules_source.description: The service that builds the rules of the AI Receptionist (e.g., "webaiwidgetserver", "aiagents").

page.description: The page returned, starting at 1 (e.g., 1). Present only with `page`.

per_page.description: The page size (e.g., 25). Present only with `page`.

total.description: The number of rules that match the filters (e.g., 42). Present only with `page`.

business_rule_categories.description: The catalog categories that match the filters, ordered by `sort_order`.

Bearer.description: Provide a valid bearer token in the Authorization header. Example: 'Authorization: Bearer {app_token}'

post.summary: Create a Business Rules Bulk Import
post.description:
## Overview
Create an async job to extract business rules from raw text using LLM. The system analyzes content, extracts rules, classifies by category, and deduplicates against existing rules.

## Webhook Notification
When the job completes, a webhook notification will be sent to subscribers of the `business_rules_bulk_import/completed` event. The webhook payload includes the complete list of created business rules.

**To receive notifications:**
1. Subscribe to the webhook event: `POST /platform/v1/webhook/subscribe` with `{"event": "business_rules_bulk_import/completed", "target_url": "https://your-domain.com/webhook"}`
2. Your webhook will receive the job results including all created business rules

**Webhook Payload Structure:**
The payload is flat. A completed job lists the created rules:
```json
{
  "event": "business_rules_bulk_import/completed",
  "job_uid": "6f0c2b1e-8a4d-4f3b-9c2e-1d5a7b9c3e4f",
  "business_uid": "9i3ap2o3aw3gktlo",
  "staff_uid": "x1y2z3",
  "status": "completed",
  "completed_at": "2026-11-09T10:30:00.000Z",
  "business_rules": [
    {
      "uid": "c2d6b8a0-1f0e-4a1b-9c3d-2e4f5a6b7c8d",
      "category_code": "policies_and_info",
      "topic": "reply_to_clients",
      "effective_load_mode": "always",
      "content": "Returns are accepted within 30 days",
      "status": "active",
      "source": "system"
    }
  ]
}
```
A failed job has `status: failed`, `error_message` and `error_code`:
* `TIMED_OUT` - no result arrived within 35 minutes. A new import can start after this.
* `GENERATION_FAILED` - the rule generation failed.
* `PUBLISH_FAILED` - the job could not be sent for processing.

Content can hold any UTF-8 text. Control characters other than tab, line feed and carriage return return 400. Duplicate rules in one result are created once. Bulk rules are `partner` rules with `entry_point: partner_bulk_import`.

Available for **Staff** tokens with `account.settings.manage`.

schema.description: Request to create a bulk import job for business rules extraction

content.description: Raw unstructured text content to analyze for rule extraction (e.g., business profile, email threads, policy documents). Maximum 50KB (51,200 characters).

category_code.description: The category of business rules to extract from the content. All extracted rules will be assigned to this category. If no category supplied, the system will attempt to infer the category based on the content. It must be the code of an active catalog category, see `GET /v3/ai/business_rule_categories?is_active=true` (e.g., "policies_and_info", "faq"). An unknown code returns 400 with the code `INVALID_CATEGORY_CODE`.

schema_description.description: Optional description of the content structure to help LLM understand the format (e.g., "Structured business profile from onboarding intake. Fields: business identity, hours, About Us narrative, services list, service area, special notes."). Maximum 500 characters.

ingestion_prompt.description: Optional instructions for the LLM on how to extract and categorize rules from the content (e.g., "Extract FAQ pairs from services. Infer tone from About Us. Special Notes become individual policies_and_info rules."). Maximum 500 characters.

get.description:
## Overview
Get the business rules of the authenticated business.

Without `topics`, or for a business on `rules_mode = legacy`, the response is the legacy list: every rule of the business, ordered by `category_code` and `sort_order` unless `sort` says otherwise, and narrowed only by the filters the request sends.

With `topics` and a business on `rules_mode = topics`, the response is the scoped list: the rules of those topics with status `active` and effective load mode `always`, ordered by the catalog `sort_order`, then the rule `sort_order`, then `uid`. An explicit `status` or `load_mode` replaces these defaults. `sort` has no effect on the scoped list. A reader sends its `topics` in both modes and reads `meta.rules_mode` to know which list it got.

Without `page` the response holds every matching rule, at most 500. When the cap cuts the list, the response carries the header `Warning: 299 - "unpaginated list capped at 500 rows; use page and per_page"`.

`meta` always carries `rules_mode`, `gate_mode` and `receptionist_rules_source`. With `page` it also carries `page`, `per_page` and `total`.

Available for **Staff** tokens.

parameters.name: category_code
parameters.description: Filter by catalog category code(s). Accepts a single value, a repeated parameter, or a comma-separated list (e.g., "?category_code=faq", "?category_code=faq&category_code=tone_of_voice", "?category_code=faq,tone_of_voice"). Every code of the catalog is accepted. An unknown value returns 400. Omit to retrieve every category.

parameters.name: topics
parameters.description:
The topics the reader loads, comma-separated or repeated (e.g., "reply_to_clients,preferences"). For a business on `rules_mode = topics` the response is the scoped list of these topics. For a business on `legacy` the response is the legacy list. An unknown topic returns 400.

Available values: `reply_to_clients`, `ai_receptionist`, `bizai_chat`, `notes`, `preferences`, `knowledge_and_files`.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by status, comma-separated or repeated (e.g., "active", "active,inactive"). The scoped list uses `active` when the request does not send it.

parameters.name: load_mode
parameters.description: Filter by the effective load mode: the own load mode of the rule, or the default load mode of its catalog category (e.g., "always", "always,search"). The scoped list uses `always` when the request does not send it.

parameters.name: author_type
parameters.description: Filter by author type, comma-separated or repeated (e.g., "owner", "owner,owner_via_ai").

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1 (e.g., 1). When omitted, the response is unpaged (at most 500 rules) and `meta` has no paging fields.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rules per page, used only together with `page` (e.g., 25). Defaults to 25, at most 100.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort clauses as `field:asc|desc`, comma-separated, over `category_code`, `sort_order`, `created_at` and `updated_at` (e.g., "category_code:asc,sort_order:asc"). An unknown field or direction returns 400. The scoped list ignores it.

200.description: Business rules retrieved successfully. The example shows a paged scoped list of a business on `rules_mode = topics`.

post.description:
## Overview
Create a new business rule for the authenticated business. The business comes from the token.

Every new rule gets a topic (`topic`, `placed_by`) and an author (`author_type`, `entry_point`, `confirmed_at`, derived `tier` and `source`). See `topic` and `entry_point` in the body for the rules. `metadata` and `evidence` are stored only for an app token that acts for a staff member.

A business can hold at most 1,000 rules and at most 100 rules with effective load mode `always` in one topic. A write over a limit returns 422 `rule_limit_reached`.

## Partners
A partner app can write in two ways. With a staff token, the rule is an `owner` rule. With an app token that acts for a staff member, the rule is a `partner` rule and is not confirmed, so agents rank it below the owner's rules.

## Webhooks
Every create, update and delete sends the webhook `business_rule/created`, `business_rule/updated` or `business_rule/deleted` (subscribe with `POST /platform/v1/webhook/subscribe`), within about 10 seconds and at least once. Deduplicate by `business_rule.uid` and `business_rule.updated_at`. Payload:
```json
{
  "event": "business_rule/created",
  "business_uid": "9i3ap2o3aw3gktlo",
  "business_rule": {
    "uid": "c2d6b8a0-1f0e-4a1b-9c3d-2e4f5a6b7c8d",
    "category_code": "tone_of_voice",
    "topic": "reply_to_clients",
    "content": "Always use a friendly tone",
    "status": "active",
    "author_type": "owner",
    "tier": "owner",
    "effective_load_mode": "always",
    "updated_at": "2026-11-09T10:00:00.000Z",
    "deleted_at": null
  }
}
```
`business_rule` has the fields of the rule in the API response, plus `deleted_at`. Rules that a bulk import creates send no `business_rule/created` webhook; the `business_rules_bulk_import/completed` webhook lists them.

Available for **Staff** tokens with `account.settings.manage`.

## Overview
Update a business rule of the authenticated business by UID. The fields in the body change. A content change sets the author again from the token and `entry_point`; a change of only `status` or `sort_order` keeps it. A rule without a topic gets one on any update. A rule of another business, or a deleted rule, returns 404. An update that moves a rule into a topic or into load mode `always` over the limit returns 422 `rule_limit_reached`. The update sends the webhook `business_rule/updated`.

Available for **Staff** tokens with `account.settings.manage`.

Available for **Staff** tokens with `account.settings.manage`.

List the catalog of business rule categories, ordered by `sort_order`. vcita manages the catalog. Each category belongs to one topic and has a default load mode. `label_key` and `description` are translation keys.

A category with `is_active = false` belongs to a topic that is not open yet. Writes accept only the codes of active categories.

Available for every authenticated token.
